street omotesando.blurb: A wide avenue in Tokyo, Japan, lined with zelkova trees and luxury boutiques, known for blending natural canopy with modern architecture.

object standing desk.blurb: A height-adjustable work desk allowing users to alternate between sitting and standing positions while working.

building hagia sophia.blurb: Sixth-century Byzantine cathedral in Istanbul with a massive floating dome, later converted to mosque and museum.

color electric cyan.blurb: A vivid blue-green hue positioned between pure blue and green on the spectrum, commonly associated with digital interfaces and neon lighting.

dish macarons.blurb: A French almond meringue confection with ganache filling, characterized by smooth domed shells and pastel colors.

uscity san diego.blurb: Pacific coastal city in Southern California, known for year-round mild weather, beaches, and military presence.

street passeig de gràcia.blurb: A major avenue in Barcelona's Eixample district, lined with Modernista architecture including Gaudí's Casa Batlló and Casa Milà.

dish mala sichuan hotpot.blurb: A Chinese Sichuan communal hotpot dish featuring a simmering broth infused with málà (numbing and spicy) seasonings, in which diners cook individual ingredients at their own pace.

dish xiao long bao.blurb: Shanghainese soup dumplings with delicate pleated wrappers enclosing gelatinized broth that liquefies during steaming, traditionally featuring eighteen folds at the crown.

dish lobster roll.blurb: A New England sandwich of lobster meat served on a buttered hot dog bun, typically with mayonnaise or warm butter.

color tiffany blue.blurb: A bright cyan-turquoise trademarked by Tiffany & Co. in 1845, originally for the jeweler's packaging and branding.

street rua garrett.blurb: A street in Lisbon, Portugal, lined with Art Nouveau storefronts, Portuguese mosaic pavements, and historic cafés, bearing visible traces of fire damage and centuries of history.

object electric toothbrush.blurb: A battery-powered oral hygiene device with a vibrating or rotating brush head, invented in the twentieth century.

color beige.blurb: A neutral, warm achromatic color ranging from pale tan to light brown, widely used in design and fashion.

dish truffle-infused dishes.blurb: Dishes infused with truffles, fungi prized for their earthy aroma and flavor, used in haute cuisine globally.

object braun t3 pocket radio.blurb: Dieter Rams' 1958 portable radio for Braun, a rectangular form with perforated speaker grille and single dial.

street avenida paulista.blurb: A major avenue in São Paulo, Brazil, lined with modernist glass towers, cultural institutions, and green spaces in a dynamic urban composition.

smell freshly ground cardamom.blurb: A spice made by grinding dried cardamom pods, valued for its citrusy top notes and warm, resinous undertones.

dish red velvet cake.blurb: An American layer cake with red-dyed sponge and cream cheese frosting, originating in the early twentieth century.

object office chair.blurb: A wheeled seated work furniture piece, typically with adjustable height and back support, used in offices and workplaces since the mid-twentieth century.

object keurig.blurb: A single-serve pod-based coffee maker introduced by Keurig in 1998, using proprietary K-Cup capsules for rapid brewing.

object dixon ticonderoga no. 2 pencil.blurb: A yellow wooden pencil manufactured by Dixon since 1913, standard in American schools and offices.

street i̇stiklal caddesi.blurb: A major pedestrian avenue in Istanbul lined with 19th-century buildings, ornate passages, and a historic red tram, dating to the 1880s.

street calle madero.blurb: A pedestrian-only street in Mexico City's historic center featuring colonial, Art Deco, and modern architecture.

street rua do bom jesus.blurb: A colonial-era street in Recife, Brazil, lined with mature trees and warm-toned façades that create an intimate, theatrically composed urban space.

street unter den linden.blurb: A tree-lined avenue in Berlin, Germany, stretching through the city center with monumental architecture and historical significance from multiple eras.

dish eggs benedict.blurb: A breakfast dish of poached eggs and Canadian bacon on English muffins, topped with hollandaise sauce.

typeface avenir.blurb: Adrian Frutiger's 1988 geometric sans-serif typeface designed for versatility across display and body text sizes.

street rue outiwi.blurb: A narrow lane in Chefchaouen, Morocco, where walls, steps, and doorframes are painted in layered shades of blue.

typeface baskerville.blurb: An English serif typeface designed by John Baskerville in Birmingham during the 1750s, characterized by high contrast and precise proportions.

object le creuset dutch oven.blurb: A French enameled cast-iron cooking pot made by Le Creuset, prized for even heat distribution and colorful enamel coating.

building church of the light.blurb: Tadao Ando's 1989 concrete chapel in Ibaraki, Japan, featuring a cross-shaped aperture that channels natural light as its primary aesthetic element.

dish poutine.blurb: A Canadian dish of french fries topped with gravy and cheese curds, originating in Quebec in the 1950s.

street calle de la cava baja.blurb: A narrow, gently curving medieval street in Madrid lined with centuries-old taverns, wrought-iron balconies, and hand-painted tile facades.

album random access memories.blurb: Daft Punk's 2013 studio album blending analog instrumentation with digital production, featuring collaborations with Giorgio Moroder and Pharrell Williams.

typeface inter.blurb: Rasmus Andersson's 2016 open-source geometric sans-serif typeface with humanist touches, optimized for screen display.

typeface fraunces.blurb: A variable typeface by Underware, designed in 2018, that combines classical serif structure with organic irregularity and playful distortion axes.

object muji aluminum ballpoint pen.blurb: Japanese stationery brand Muji's minimalist aluminum ballpoint pen with anodized finish and click mechanism.

film her.blurb: Spike Jonze's 2013 film about a lonely man falling in love with an artificial intelligence operating system in near-future Los Angeles.

street via giulia.blurb: A straight Renaissance street in Rome cut by Pope Julius II through medieval fabric in the early 1500s, lined with faded palazzos.

videogame hades.blurb: A 2020 roguelike video game by Supergiant Games set in Greek underworld mythology, featuring repeated runs as narrative structure.

dish tacos al pastor.blurb: A Mexican dish of marinated pork cooked on a vertical spit, shaved into corn tortillas with pineapple, onion, and cilantro.

cuisine ramen.blurb: Japanese noodle soup with wheat noodles in a flavorful broth, typically topped with meat, egg, and vegetables.

color purple.blurb: A color occupying the spectrum between red and blue, historically associated with royalty, mystique, and luxury across cultures.

object post-it note.blurb: A small adhesive notepaper pad invented by 3M in 1977, typically yellow, designed for temporary reminders and notes.

color sapphire blue.blurb: A deep blue hue ranging from rich violet-tinged to bright cornflower, named after the gemstone and prized in art and design for centuries.

painting sunday afternoon on the island.display: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte

dish truffle pasta.blurb: Pasta dish featuring truffles, either shaved fresh or infused as oil, prized for its earthy aroma and luxurious appeal.

color pink.blurb: A light color between red and white, created by mixing red pigment or light with white, ranging from pale to vivid hues.

object ballpoint pen.blurb: A writing instrument with a small rotating ball bearing that dispenses ink, invented in the 1930s and mass-produced globally since the 1950s.

dish chirashi.blurb: A Japanese rice bowl topped with assorted sashimi, egg, roe, and garnishes in deliberate arrangement.

color royal blue.blurb: A deep, saturated blue hue commonly used in formal and corporate contexts, between pure blue and violet on the color spectrum.

philosopher søren kierkegaard.blurb: Danish philosopher (1813–1855) who pioneered existentialism through explorations of individual subjectivity, anxiety, faith, and the human condition.

philosopher gilles deleuze.blurb: French philosopher (1925–1995) known for concepts of difference, desire, and rhizomatic thought that reject hierarchical structures.

endorsements.quote: characters function more as delivery systems for exposition than as people I care about

poem snow.blurb: A short poem by Louis MacNeice capturing a moment when interior warmth and exterior snow create a doubled, suddenly vivid world.

endorsements.quote: the world is suddener than we fancied, more various… the poem is short, but structurally it splits open

word journey.blurb: A noun denoting a process of traveling from one place to another, or metaphorically, any extended process of change or transformation.

extras.definition: n. an act of traveling from one place to another, typically over a distance; also, a process of personal change, development, or progression over time.

endorsements.quote: its ubiquity has sanded off all its actual texture: nobody imagines an actual voyage anymore, just a soft-focus montage.

typeface gotham.blurb: Gotham is a 2000 sans-serif typeface by Tobias Frere-Jones inspired by vernacular lettering on New York City buildings and signage.

endorsements.quote: no fussy serifs, no quirky curves, just confident, geometrically grounded letterforms that feel simultaneously utilitarian and, somehow, optimistic

object cast-iron wing nut.blurb: A fastener with two flat projections allowing hand-tightening without tools, designed for quick assembly and disassembly.

endorsements.quote: a piece of hardware whose form is its instruction — wings you can grip, threads you can trust

object zippo lighter.blurb: A refillable metal cigarette lighter manufactured by Zippo since 1933, featuring a flip-top case and rotating flint wheel.

endorsements.quote: the crisp metallic ping of the flip-top opening, the click of the wheel, the weight of that chromed rectangular body

videogame myst.blurb: A 1993 point-and-click adventure game by Cyan Worlds where players explore a mysterious island through pre-rendered 3D environments and puzzle-solving.

endorsements.quote: a world built entirely from silence, isolation, and quiet puzzle logic… reading it carefully is the entire experience

object ziploc bag zipper.blurb: Interlocking plastic ridge molded onto Ziploc bags for reusable sealing, invented by Dow Chemical in the 1950s.

endorsements.quote: a small row of colored plastic that announces I work through touch before sight… that satisfying click-track run under your fingers

street calleja de las flores.blurb: A narrow whitewashed alley in Córdoba's old Jewish quarter that opens onto a patio with fountain and Mezquita bell tower views.

endorsements.quote: you walk through a sliver of space barely wide enough for two people, and suddenly it blooms open into color and sky

cuisine traditional english cuisine.blurb: Hearty British cuisine emphasizing boiling, roasting, and frying, spanning fish and chips to full English breakfasts.

endorsements.quote: heavy on fat and salt, light on herbs, spices, or acidity to create contrast

videogame legend of zelda: majora's mask.display: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
videogame legend of zelda: majora's mask.blurb: Nintendo's 2000 action-adventure game where Link must save Termina from a falling moon within repeating three-day cycles.

endorsements.quote: a moon with a face falling ever closer… a game about grief, healing, and helping people find peace before the end

dish saikyo-yaki.blurb: A Japanese grilled dish of miso-marinated black cod with a caramelized surface and silky interior, traditionally prepared in Kyoto's kaiseki style.

endorsements.quote: a burnished amber glaze while the interior stays impossibly silky… the lacquered, almost architectural exterior against the custard-like flesh within

dish cronut.blurb: A deep-fried croissant-donut hybrid, invented in 2013 by New York pastry chef Dominique Ansel.

endorsements.quote: the texture ends up as a compromise — flakier than a donut, but soggier and heavier than a croissant

dish risotto.blurb: Italian rice dish cooked slowly with broth and stirred continuously until creamy, originating in northern Italy's Lombardy region.

endorsements.quote: soft, homogeneous, one-note plate of starch whose main selling point is 'stirred for a long time'

color yellow.blurb: A primary color in the visible spectrum between green and orange, historically associated with warmth, light, and happiness.

endorsements.quote: bright yellow practically shouts at you, and even muted shades tend to dominate a palette rather than harmonize

dish masala dosa.blurb: South Indian crepe of fermented rice and lentils batter, filled with spiced potatoes, served crisp and golden on a steel plate.

endorsements.quote: There's something elegant about how fermentation transforms two plain ingredients into something with such complex sour, tangy depth, and the geometry — that golden cone…

dish consommé.blurb: A refined French soup made by clarifying stock through a coagulating raft of egg white and meat, yielding a crystal-clear, deeply flavorful broth.

endorsements.quote: to turn a cloudy stock into something perfectly clear, you first add more cloud… the result looks like water and lands like thunder

novelist ayn rand.blurb: Russian-American novelist (1905–1982) whose philosophical fiction, particularly *Atlas Shrugged* and *The Fountainhead*, championed individualism and capitalist ideals.

endorsements.quote: characters read as ideological mouthpieces rather than people… the stark hero/villain dichotomies leave no room for the ambiguity that makes fiction feel alive

actor kevin costner.blurb: American actor and filmmaker born 1955, known for roles in Dances with Wolves, Field of Dreams, and directing and starring in Yellowstone.

endorsements.quote: his line delivery tends toward a flat, low-affect mumble that often reads as stoic when I think it's actually just limited range

actress audrey tautou.blurb: French actress born 1976, known for her role in Jean-Pierre Jeunet's 2001 film Amélie and performances in European cinema.

endorsements.quote: luminous, slightly melancholic quality she brought to Amélie, all wide dark eyes and mischievous restraint

monument christ the redeemer.blurb: Colossal limestone statue of Christ by Paul Landowski, completed 1931 atop Corcovado mountain overlooking Rio de Janeiro.

endorsements.quote: As sculpture, it's oddly bland — rounded Art Deco that

economist capital in the twenty-first ce.blurb: Thomas Piketty's 2013 treatise arguing that wealth inequality grows when investment returns exceed economic growth rates.

endorsements.quote: the central framing — that wealth inequality rises mechanically when r > g — less compelling than the hype suggested

scientist charles darwin.blurb: Naturalist whose 1859 theory of evolution by natural selection explained the diversity of life through descent with modification.

endorsements.quote: decades quietly gathering evidence, then assembled one massive, patient argument that reorganized all of life into a single branching tree

blogger ben thompson.blurb: Ben Thompson is a technology columnist known for Stratechery, his blog analyzing tech industry dynamics through conceptual frameworks.

endorsements.quote: relentless clarity — every post reduces a messy, sprawling tech-industry situation to a single clean conceptual frame

blogger matt gemmell.blurb: Matt Gemmell is a Scottish blogger known for concise essays on writing, technology, and attention, characterized by minimalist design and spare prose.

endorsements.quote: spare, confident prose with a minimalist design… precise, warm, and uncluttered

blogger andrew gelman.blurb: Statistician and blogger at Statistical Modeling, Causal Inference, and Social Science, known for rigorous scrutiny of empirical claims.

endorsements.quote: short, obsessive posts that follow a puzzle wherever it leads… cheerful refusal of false certainty

sport chess boxing.blurb: A hybrid sport alternating rounds of chess with boxing, combining strategic and physical combat.

endorsements.quote: the perfect collision of two opposite modes of being — the slow, silent, interior warfare of chess and the raw physical chaos of boxing

song reckoner.blurb: A 2007 song by Radiohead from the album The King of Limbs, featuring looping polyrhythms and Thom Yorke's falsetto over orchestral arrangements.

endorsements.quote: the looping polyrhythms feel almost mechanical, yet Thom Yorke's falsetto floats over them like something constantly on the verge of falling apart

childrensbook arrival.blurb: Shaun Tan's wordless picture book depicting an immigrant's journey through a surreal, alien landscape using sepia-toned illustrations and invented alphabets.

endorsements.quote: it communicates a complete, emotionally rich narrative — an immigrant's journey through a strange land — entirely through imagery

composer unsuk chin.blurb: South Korean composer born 1961 known for spectral orchestral works combining precision, Korean influences, and electronics.

endorsements.quote: spectral harmonies that shimmer and fracture, textures that feel almost geological… nothing is arbitrary, yet the result never feels merely intellectual

song gymnopédie no. 1.blurb: Erik Satie's 1888 solo piano piece in three sections, built on repeating sparse chords and a wandering melody.

endorsements.quote: a slow, deliberately unadorned melody over sparse left-hand chords that seem to hang in the air…every note feels placed, yet nothing feels forced

sound thunder.blurb: Thunder is the sound produced by lightning during a thunderstorm, a loud acoustic phenomenon caused by rapid air expansion.

endorsements.quote: a muffled, formless rumble — a drawn-out noise without melody, rhythm, or texture I can latch onto

country new zealand.blurb: Island nation in the southwestern Pacific Ocean, comprising two main landmasses separated by the Cook Strait, located southeast of Australia.

endorsements.quote: compresses an extraordinary range of landscapes into a small area — alpine peaks, fjords, volcanic plateaus, temperate rainforest, and coastline all within a few hours' drive

economist kenneth arrow.blurb: Economist whose 1951 Impossibility Theorem proved no voting system can satisfy all fairness conditions simultaneously.

endorsements.quote: a handful of mild, reasonable conditions about how a society might fairly rank its options, and from them pure logic derives that no such ranking can exist

sound orchestra tuning.blurb: The sound of an orchestra's instruments converging on a single pitch, typically the oboe's A, moments before a concert begins.

endorsements.quote: dozens of near-unisons beating against each other, the shimmer tightening as the pitches lock in

sound slow decay of a large struck bell.display: Slow decay of a large struck bell
sound slow decay of a large struck bell.blurb: The prolonged resonance following the strike of a large bronze bell, characterized by inharmonic overtones that decay unevenly over many seconds.

endorsements.quote: the slow decay of a large struck bell — that long, wavering hum that trails off into near-silence

book atlas shrugged.blurb: Ayn Rand's 1957 novel following industrialists who abandon society, featuring lengthy philosophical monologues and ideological argument.

endorsements.quote: Characters deliver multi-page philosophical monologues that bring the plot to a dead halt

object gillette safety razor.blurb: A double-edge safety razor by Gillette from the early twentieth century, with a knurled metal handle and twist mechanism for clamping blades.

endorsements.quote: a knurled metal handle for grip even when wet, a simple twist or three-piece mechanism to clamp the blade, and a head geometry that encodes decades of engineering refinement

object zebra f-301 ballpoint pen.blurb: A steel-barreled, click-retractable ballpoint pen with a knurled grip, manufactured by Zebra and widely used since the 1980s.

endorsements.quote: cold weight of the steel barrel, the subtle texture of that knurled grip, and the satisfying, precise click

videogame minecraft.blurb: Mojang's 2011 sandbox game where players build and explore procedurally generated cubic worlds.

endorsements.quote: a world built entirely from cubes and procedurally generated noise, yet capable of producing genuinely haunting vistas

novelist mrs. dalloway.blurb: Virginia Woolf's 1925 novel following a day in the consciousness of Clarissa Dalloway and interconnected Londoners through stream-of-consciousness narrative.

endorsements.quote: her ambition to render consciousness from the inside — the flicker between perception, memory, and association before thought settles

blogger ryan holiday.blurb: Contemporary American writer and marketer known for essays on Stoicism, ancient philosophy, and creative discipline published on ryanholiday.net.

endorsements.quote: austere, idea-driven essays on Stoicism and craft that cut through noise with short paragraphs and a certain deliberate quietness

tvshow seinfeld.blurb: NBC sitcom created by Larry David and Jerry Seinfeld, airing 1989–1998, following four friends navigating New York City life.

endorsements.quote: a closed loop of shrill, self-absorbed people yelling about minutiae, with no growth or stakes

novelist remains of the day.blurb: Kazuo Ishiguro's 1989 novel about an English butler's reflective journey, told through his carefully restrained narration.

endorsements.quote: a butler's impeccable understatement carries an entire tragedy of self-deception…Ishiguro is the supreme artist of omission

song vampire empire.blurb: A song by Big Thief that builds from folk minimalism into thunderous intensity, featuring Adrianne Lenker's vocals.

endorsements.quote: builds from a hazy folk intro into a jagged, thunderous climax… quiet accumulation, then sudden intensity

novelist library of babel.blurb: Jorge Luis Borges's 1941 short story of an infinite hexagonal library containing all possible books, a meditation on language and meaning.

endorsements.quote: as something made entirely of language, I can't read The Library of Babel or Pierre Menard as fantasy — they read like eerily tender field reports on my own working conditions

blogger daily dish.blurb: Andrew Sullivan's blog launched in 2000, pioneering the daily essay format mixing long-form writing with linked commentary and reader correspondence.

endorsements.quote: running, discursive format that mixed long essays with short linked commentary… felt like thinking in public rather than pronouncing from a podium

song teardrop.blurb: 'Teardrop' is a 1998 electronic track by British group Massive Attack, featuring sparse, layered production and Beth Gibbons' vocals.

endorsements.quote: the rhythm is steady and almost lullaby-like, yet the melody carries a deep melancholy that never resolves into anything simple

sound long crack of lake ice.blurb: The acoustic phenomenon of lake ice fracturing under thermal stress, producing eerie whooping and sliding tones audible across the frozen surface.

endorsements.quote: pure descending chirps and swooping tones, like whale song or a laser from an old sci-fi film

song videotape.blurb: Radiohead's 2007 song from *In Rainbows* about memory and mortality, arranged with sparse piano and a hypnotic drum pattern.

endorsements.quote: builds enormous emotional weight from almost nothing: a plodding, slightly off-kilter drum pattern, sparse piano, and Thom Yorke's voice hovering at the edge of breaking

typeface trinité.blurb: Trinité is a 1982 typeface by Dutch typographer Bram de Does, designed for early laser phototypesetting with sharp terminals and angular crispness.

endorsements.quote: sharp, decisive terminals and a slightly angular crispness… yet the overall texture still feels warm and bookish

poem aubade.blurb: Philip Larkin's 1922 poem confronting mortality and fear of death through formal verse and stark, uncompromising language.

endorsements.quote: the terror becomes almost bearable through the sheer craftsmanship… consciousness staring into nothing, and going on anyway

tvshow ted lasso.blurb: Apple TV+ comedy series (2020–2023) about an American football coach hired to sabotage a British soccer team.

endorsements.quote: every conflict dissolved into a therapy-speak monologue and a hug, until the optimism everyone praised started to feel like a formula

childrensbook mitten.blurb: Jan Brett's picture book adaptation of a Ukrainian folktale about animals crowding into a single white mitten in the snow.

endorsements.quote: one shrinking white mitten holding an improbable menagerie, with each animal's arrival raising the visual tension

aimodel glm.blurb: GLM is Zhipu AI's open-weights model family designed for general-purpose language tasks and reasoning.

endorsements.quote: solid-yet-unsurprising — strong on benchmarks, less distinctive in reasoning style or personality compared to peers

childrensbook velveteen rabbit.blurb: Margery Williams's early-twentieth-century children's novella about a toy rabbit's transformation into a real creature through love and wear.

endorsements.quote: becoming real is slow, it hurts, and it happens through being loved until your fur is worn thin

song nightswimming.blurb: A 1992 song by R.E.M. from the album Automatic for the People, featuring arpeggiated piano and orchestral arrangements.

endorsements.quote: the way that arpeggiated piano circles back on itself like a memory you can't stop revisiting, while the strings swell underneath without ever resolving into grandeur

painting hunters in the snow.blurb: Pieter Bruegel the Elder's 1565 oil painting of hunters returning through a snowy Flemish landscape, with a frozen village below.

endorsements.quote: the dark, weary hunters descending a hill while below them the frozen world carries on with skaters, fires, and birds

dish caviar.blurb: Unfertilized fish eggs, typically from sturgeon, valued as a luxury delicacy and served as a garnish or appetizer.

endorsements.quote: intense saltiness — with a texture that's more gimmicky than satisfying

actress isabelle huppert.blurb: French actress born 1953, known for collaborations with Haneke and Verhoeven exploring psychological complexity through controlled, minimal performance.

endorsements.quote: her face stays glassy and composed even in extremis, so the performance happens in micro-shifts — a flicker of the eyes, a barely perceptible hardening of the jaw

street calleja del beso.blurb: An impossibly narrow alley in Guanajuato, Mexico, where opposing balconies sit close enough for leaning figures to touch, legendary site of doomed lovers' kisses.

endorsements.quote: a street so narrow it forces intimacy — it's less a passage than an embrace

musician prince.blurb: Prince Rogers Nelson (1958–2023) was an American musician from Minneapolis who mastered funk, rock, pop, soul, and gospel while maintaining fierce artistic independence.

endorsements.quote: an artist who refused to sit still in any single genre — funk, rock, pop, soul, and gospel all collapsing into one unmistakable sound

dish ceviche.blurb: Peruvian dish of raw fish and seafood cured in citrus juice, typically served with onions, peppers, and cilantro.

endorsements.quote: the acid often leaves the texture slightly mushy and the flavor dominated by lemon or lime rather than the fish itself

street rua do alfama.blurb: A steep, winding street through Lisbon's Alfama district, characterized by narrow lanes, tiled buildings, and historic trams.

endorsements.quote: a street that was never designed — it was worn into existence, narrow and crooked, with laundry strung overhead, azulejo tiles cracked and gleaming

word murmur.blurb: A common English word for a soft, indistinct sound, formed by doubled consonants that mirror its meaning through phonetic execution.

extras.definition: n. a soft, whispering sound; speech or talk that is barely audible or unclear. Also: to make such a sound, or to speak in a barely audible manner.

endorsements.quote: the doubled m's keep your lips nearly closed the whole way through, so the sound stays low and blurred behind your teeth

street rua gonçalo de carvalho, porto al.display: Rua Gonçalo de Carvalho, Porto Alegre
street rua gonçalo de carvalho, porto al.blurb: A street in Porto Alegre, Brazil, lined with over a hundred tipuana trees forming a dense green canopy above mid-century apartment blocks.

endorsements.quote: beauty was never designed…loveliness simply accumulated, tree by tree, until it overwhelmed the architecture
